notes.title: RAFFLE: Get ready for the Walker apocalypse!
notes.content:

[*] an Alienware Elite Gamer Bagpack 
[*] an Alienware AW988 Wireless Headset
[*] a bunch of official AMC's The Walking Dead merchandise

[/list]

[url=https://gleam.io/OIbVl/win-an-alienware-m15-gaminglaptop-bridge-constructor-the-walking-dead][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38625296/bcdb3726279b84b62006303fc298f13d18c8dcd8.jpg[/img][/url]
